effectsRevision.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Refine the supplied pixel-art VFX reference into a precisely separated production sprite sheet. Preserve the four effect identities, palette and six-frame progressions. Critical correction: ALL 24 effects must be SMALL, isolated, and fully contained inside their respective 256x256 cells with at least 56 transparent pixels on EVERY side. Source image particles were too large and overlapped cell boundaries. Make effects at most 140x140 pixels, centered exactly at local (128,128). Projectile diameter70px. NO faint particles, smoke haze or alpha outside each 144x144 centered region. Do not fill background with gradient: genuine transparent RGBA with exactly zero alpha outside those centered regions, no drop shadows/backing.
Output PNG1536x1024, invisible grid6columns4rows, exactly24 effects no text. Row0 six subtle tumbling stages of same compact irregular orange ochre fungal lump with charcoal cavities. Row1 six-stage spore impact burst, small puff then expands ONLY within140px and dissipates to a few visible flecks in finalcell. Row2 six-stage LOOP of persistent dirty yellow/olive spore cloud: keep same140x110px oval silhouette and similar opacity everyframe, internal billowing not progressive expansion. Row3 six-stage boss ground slam dusty ring, expanding grey-brown dust and ochre debris, maximum140x100px then dissipates. Crisp square pixel clusters, dark postapocalyptic palette, no photoreal blur. Never touch cell edges, no particles connecting neighbors. No character, scenery, floor, lettering, grid, glow, blood, watermark. Exactly24 small centered sprites surrounded by generous EMPTY transparent space.
effectsRevision.notes: Second generated VFX layout. Export uses connected-component ownership around calibrated centers to retain complete particle clusters.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D pixel-art sprite sheet for a top-down survival game. Input image is a character identity/palette/camera REFERENCE ONLY, views left to right south/front, west/left profile, east/right profile, north/back. Generate the SAME character performing NEW action.
Output transparent PNG 1536x1024, invisible 6-column by 4-row grid of 256x256 cells, EXACTLY 24 isolated sprites. Rows order SOUTH, WEST, EAST, NORTH. Each row same action six successive poses, left to right. Maintain its named facing through the whole row, rear row shows back and back of heads/clothing, no camera orbit. Fixed elevated 3/4 top-down game camera. Same scale per cell and through action, first neutral body height about 155 pixels, planted ground baseline local y=207, feet centered x=128. All body parts inside each cell with generous 20px margin, no overlap into neighboring cells. Crisp square pixel clusters, dark charcoal/olive and warm fungal orange palette, consistent upper-left light, reference pixel density. True transparent alpha, no backgrounds, floor, shadow, particles, text, grids, logos, blur, glow, gore, weapons. Six genuine hand-posed silhouettes with articulated limbs, never a transformed/repeated single sprite. End returns to usable combat stance except charged loop pose.
Subject: Bloater as reference, very broad stocky heavy infected with large layered orange fungal armor plates, charcoal trousers, huge fists. ACTION: throw a fungal growth. Six poses: 0 neutral hunched standing; 1 hand grips and plucks a compact orange fungal growth off shoulder plate; 2 throwing arm cocked overhead with small growth held in hand; 3 explosive forward throwing motion, open EMPTY throwing hand at release; 4 follow-through leaning forward, throwing arm extended; 5 recovery combat stance. Growth visible only attached to hand in frames1-2. Do NOT draw a free airborne projectile or cloud: those are separate game assets. Keep body facing row direction, throwing motion goes toward that direction.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art GAME VFX sprite sheet. No input character needed. Transparent PNG 1536x1024, 6 columns x4rows invisible grid, each cell256x256. Exactly24 separate effects, centered local(128,128), fully within each cell with 24px empty margins. No characters, ground, shadows, panels, text, grid, backdrop, glow haze or watermark. Crisp square pixel clusters matching dark postapocalyptic olive charcoal ochre orange fungus. Genuine varying frame-to-frame pixel artwork, no simple digital rotations or scaling.
Row0: SIX-FRAME LOOP of a compact organic fungal projectile, dense irregular orange/ochre armored fungal lump with dark underside, little crevices and dusty pores, shown tumbling subtly about own center. Diameter approximately80px every frame, no trail. Same lump shape/identity, varied facets across frames.
Row1: SIX-FRAME ONESHOT spore impact burst, pale dirty yellow/olive spores, outward organic puff, from compact small dense eruption frame0 to broad irregular puff frames2-3 to sparse outward dissipating flecks frame5. Keep enough visible particles in every frame, no empty frame. Overall maximum190px.
Row2: SIX-FRAME ambient LOOP persistent spore cloud viewed top-down, low horizontal/oval smoky yellow olive pixel dust puffs approx185x140px, slow internal billowing/churning, no radial expansion sequence, same overall size throughout and last blends to first. Dense visible pixel cores, transparent gaps and soft alpha only at pixel edges, no diffuse background haze.
Row3: SIX-FRAME ONESHOT boss ground impact effect viewed top-down, compact grey-brown dust and ochre flecks in frame0, expanding flattened elliptical dust shock ring frames1-3, dispersing broken dusty ring frames4-5. Overallmaximum190px. Each effect fits completely in its cell, no collision with adjacent cells. One effect per cell; firstrow is tinyprojectile deliberately smaller than clouds. Do not introduce glowing fantasy magic.
